about: For each skill with an eval suite under .claude/evals/<skill>/: the digest of the skill's instructions (SKILL.md and any references/*-rules.md, not the data files beside them; the skillMd for a node skill) and its suite at the last decision, and whether the eval ran (with scores) or was skipped (with the reason and who decided). pnpm check:skill-evals fails when the digest changes. The eval costs money, so the developer decides: run it, or record a skip. Reasoning: aimeat/scripts/check-skill-evals.ts.

aimeat-writing.note: opus, 3 runs per case per arm: commit-message 1.00 with / 1.00 without (0.00), finnish-ui-copy 1.00 / 0.92 (+0.08), operator-help-line 1.00 / 0.83 (+0.17); $2.05; Jouni 2026-11-15
